## What happened

A clear and concise description of what the bug is.

## Steps to reproduce

1. Go to '…'
2. Click on '…'
3. Scroll down to '…'
4. See error

## What I expected

A clear and concise description of what you expected to happen.

## Environment

- Browser + version: [e.g. Chrome 120]
- OS: [e.g. macOS 14, Windows 11]
- App version: Settings → Acerca de → Versión
- Build id: Settings → Acerca de → Build
- Worker capability (Settings → Acerca de → Almacenamiento if
  visible, or TopBar pill): [opfs-sync / opfs-async / idb / memory]

## Screenshots / recordings

If applicable, add screenshots or a short screen recording to help
explain the problem.

## Console output

Open DevTools → Console and paste any red errors here. The Worker's
own log lives in DevTools → Application → Service Workers → Inspect.

## Additional context

Anything else that might help (network conditions, workarounds
you tried, related issues, etc.).
